_: Fingernail plate: hard alpha-keratin in three layers (thin hard dorsal, thick intermediate with fibres running across the finger, ventral), ~0.5 mm thick on fingers (toenails thicker), translucent so the colour is the bed beneath. Water content governs everything: it swells and softens strongly when wet. Values at room temperature; 'dry' means equilibrated at low humidity, 'wet' soaked. Materials research lane, mouth group, 2026-11-07.

alpha.src: NAILS optics plate_roughness 0.15 (fine longitudinal striations 0.1-0.3 mm apart, 1-5 um deep); toenail ~0.3 E

translucency.v: high over the bed (colour is the bed's capillaries); the free edge is opaque white because air under it ends the optical contact

kinetic.src: not found: no measured nail-on-surface coefficient retrieved. Glass: dry keratin on a smooth hard surface (hair and wool fibre-on-smooth values are in this band, E). Fingertip: DERLER12 skin on smooth hard surfaces dry ~0.5-1 (via skin.body). NAILTRIB10 reports water lowers friction-force fluctuation and that friction on the plate's cross-section is anisotropic

water_contact_angle_deg.src: not found; keratin surfaces are moderately hydrophobic when clean, nail polish removers and oils change it

water_absorption.src: GUNT07 human nail max uptake ~0.3 g water / g dry at 100 % RH; diffusivity measured at 32 C over 0.035-0.536 g/g; FARRAN08 moisture content rises non-linearly with RH

swelling_dry_to_wet_pct.src: FEUGH93 measured (calculated 8.8 / 20.4 / 3.8); OCR'd table via search, verify

v.hydrated_vs_dehydrated: dehydrated microhardness 2-3x hydrated; recovers in ~100-200 min of drying in air

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: a stiff plate on a soft bed: indentation is governed by the bed (E ~40 kPa as dermis, SKIN) over ~1.5 mm (E) above bone, the plate spreading the load; the plate itself is rigid in comparison

contact_damping_ratio.src: dry keratin is lightly damped; wet more

response_time_ms.src: a tap on the nail: a rigid plate on a soft bed, contact pulse set by the bed

wave_speed_m_s.src: plate shear wave sqrt(G/rho), G = 4.0/(2 x 1.35) GPa dry, rho 1300 E

damping_ratio.src: dry keratin is lightly damped; wet more

thickness_mm.src: not measured; thin, bound to the distal phalanx

compressible_to_fraction.src: capillary blood is pressed out (blanching) - slightly compressible

deform.model_note: thin curved shell, orthotropic in growth / thickness / transverse; the matrix plasticises with water (shear and torsion soften more than tension, FARRAN09)

density_kg_m3.src: alpha-keratin ~1.3 g/cm3 (hair ~1.32, recalled); nail not measured

E_GPa.src: FEUGH93 dry/wet by direction (OCR'd table via search, verify); NAIL_NI nanoindentation by layer (conditioning not stated; reported insensitive to RH)

thickness_mm.src: NAILS (R49 0.51 +- 0.06, weak); HAND [FIN] distal ~0.45 calc; toe 1.6x is NAILS E

bending_rigidity_mNm_per_m.src: D = E t^3 / 12 per unit width, t = 0.5 mm, E from FEUGH93; ignores the plate's transverse curvature, which stiffens it a lot in longitudinal bending

toughness.v: work of fracture peaks at intermediate humidity: dry nails are brittle, wet ones soft; cracks deflect along the intermediate layer's transverse fibres, so nails tear across, not along

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the E values

ambient.src: properties between FEUGH93 dry and wet; ambient water content not retrieved (keratins hold ~0.1-0.15 g/g at 50-65 % RH, hair, E)

wet.src: soaked: up to 0.3 g/g water (GUNT07), swells 7 % along growth, 22 % in thickness, 4 % across (FEUGH93), moduli drop 6-27x, hardness drops 2-3x (NAILTRIB10); recovers over hours in air

polished.src: a lacquer coat (not plate) - makeup layer, behind its own switch
